rule: A location fact (an ExtensibleList at the period end, no dimensions) names the printed line that holds a component. Code moves the component's amount from that line's row to the component's row when every condition holds; otherwise the line is left as placed and an exception is recorded.
conditions: the list holds exactly one location
the location concept is a printed line of the statement, in the same section as the component's row
the component has a fact at the same date, with no dimensions and the same unit; duplicate facts must carry one value
the component's amount is not already claimed and is not larger than the location line's amount
the location line's row differs from the component's row
